items.name: revenue attribution
items.reason: Closed-loop contribution-margin attribution is implemented as a shared analytical capability over existing engines; no new attribution engine or live business mutation is required.

items.name: source → lead → meeting → sale → margin
items.reason: The funnel-to-margin chain uses opaque CRM references and preserves CRM as source of truth. It is analytical/read-only in this scope.

items.name: campaign ROI
items.reason: Contribution-margin-first campaign ROI is implemented without ad-spend mutation, budget changes or provider writes.

items.name: agent action ROI
items.reason: Opaque agent-action references can be evaluated economically without storing sensitive worker attributes or granting execution authority.

items.name: channel ROI
items.reason: Channel ROI uses contribution margin rather than vanity metrics and remains an analytical decision input only.

items.name: WTP real
items.reason: Observed aggregate willingness-to-pay evidence is supported through the common experiment contract, with individualized/sensitive pricing forbidden and no live price mutation.

items.name: pricing experiments
items.reason: Pricing experiments reuse EXP-001 hypothesis/control/metric/decision planning; no live price, checkout or customer-specific mutation is authorized.

items.name: FREE_PARITY gate
items.reason: The deterministic HOLD/BUILD/PAY recommendation gate exists and enforces free/local parity first. Purchase or subscription execution remains disabled and MONEY_LIMIT gated.

items.name: automatic stop / scale
items.reason: Deterministic margin/ROI stop-scale recommendations exist, while actual budget, campaign or spend mutation remains disabled.
